---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "feat: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## What problem does this solve
A clear description of the problem or limitation. e.g. "SysMon doesn't show GPU usage and I can't monitor it."

## Proposed solution
Describe the feature you'd like. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Would this benefit most users?
Explain why this fits SysMon's scope and isn't just a niche use case.

## Additional context
Links, screenshots, or similar projects that implement this.
